nameCheck.why: Papua New Guinea's provinces are called "Wilayah" rarely in Malay; Malaysian atlases use "Provinsi"/"Wilayah" inconsistently, but for PNG the standard Malay kind word is "Wilayah" only for Indonesian-style usage, whereas "Wilayah Milne Bay" risks confusion and "Daerah/Provinsi Milne Bay" is more apt
